text: Program Description CIP offers four-year rigorous and practical education through lectures, expert seminars, and team-based student projects in eight semesters. Students can finish the program in minimum 3 years with good study planning. The maximum study length is 6 years. Students with good Chinese language skills before the start of the program are qualified to apply for the exemption of Chinese language courses up to 28 credits. Qualified students will have opportunities to study as an exchange student in our partner universities in another country for a semester (except for the first year and last semester in the program). Students with valid HSK level 4 certificate and GPA above 3 are qualified to apply for minor in Chinese language in the first year of study. Program Requirements Students are required to meet following requirements to graduate: Complete about 155 credits, including required courses, elective courses, thesis, community service, graduate internship and other practicum in 3-6 years. Pass all the required courses and the GPA for all the required courses is above 1.7 Submit graduation thesis and pass the thesis defense Attend minimum15 seminars and 15 immersion week activities Have minimum 90 hours of community service Have minimum 1 month of graduation internship in an organization in the last academic year, and the evaluation is above average Other practicum requirements Receive HSK level 4 certificate within 2 years before graduation (HSK is the official Chinese language proficiency test) No undue payment to the university No violation of Chinese law and regulation Conditional Admission: Applicants with IELTS below 5.5 or equivalent may be admitted conditionally and required to study in CIP Preparation Program until one’s English proficiency reaches entrance standard. Transfer Students: Only students who have been studying in a university in the similar major for more than one semester can apply for credits transfer. The official transcritps, the syllabus of the courses or other associated documents are required. CIP reserves the right to make final decision on credit transfer. Maximum of 30 credits can be transferred. SCHOLARSHIP We offer Outstanding CIP Student Scholarship to encourage current students to study harder and realize their full potential. Who : Have studied in CIP for at least one academic year Showed good motivation of study, working hard and perform well in academic study with minimum GPA of 3.5 Actively participated in various kinds of community services and extracurricular activities What: Instead of paying in cash, a tuition waiver coupon and scholarship certificate will be issued. 1st class award winner receives CNY 6000 tuition waiver of the tuition of the following semester 2nd class award winner receives CNY 4000 tuition waiver of the tuition of the following semester 3rd class award winner receives CNY 2000 tuition waiver for the tuition of the following semester How: Submit the application before the deadline announced in the end of each semester. click here for more information about Bachelor of Management in Business Administration (BBA)​
